name: Viktoria Plzeň
notes: Majority owner Michal Strnad (CSG arms and ammunition group) since Oct 2025; UEFA fine EUR 15,000 for a discriminatory 'fight the Turks' banner v Fenerbahce (Nov 2025); Betano betting sponsor on shirt back.

name: Villarreal
notes: Owner-president Fernando Roig (local industrialist) since 1997; no fan sanctions found; signed Thomas Partey in 2025 while he faced rape charges in England (not-guilty plea, trial Nov 2026), he left in 2026.

name: Walsall
notes: Trivela Group (US sports investment firm) 51% since 2022, also owns Silkeborg (80%), Drogheda and Trivela FC; Walsall was its first club, flagship status uncertain.

name: Watford
notes: Pozzo family owners since 2012, Udinese (owned since 1986) is the parent club; very high coach turnover; no fan sanctions found.

name: Werder Bremen
notes: e.V. members' club holds the majority of the KGaA, a Bremen business alliance holds 19.71%; long anti-discrimination record and anti-racist ultra groups; no sanctions found. Cups = 6 DFB-Pokal + 2006 Ligapokal.

name: West Bromwich Albion
notes: Bilkul Football WBA (Shilen and Kiran Patel, Florida) 87.7% since Feb 2024; FA fined club GBP 30,000 after crowd trouble halted the Jan 2024 FA Cup derby v Wolves.

name: West Ham United
notes: Sullivan majority, Kretinsky (Sparta Prague owner) ~27% minority; FA fine GBP 120,000 for homophobic chanting (2025); UEFA fine after objects injured Fiorentina captain at 2023 Conference League final; BoyleSports shirt sponsor; continental = 1965 Cup Winners' Cup + 2023 Conference League.

name: Wigan Athletic
notes: Owner Mike Danson since 2023; financial breaches = 12-point administration deduction (2020) and points deduction for unpaid wages (2022-23).

name: Wolverhampton Wanderers
notes: Owned by Chinese conglomerate Fosun International since 2016; FA fine GBP 100,000 for homophobic chanting v Chelsea (2023); Midnite betting shirt sponsor; fan boycotts against owners 2025-26.

name: Wrexham
notes: Reynolds and McElhenney majority since 2021, Apollo Sports Capital (PE) just under 10% plus ~5% ASC-linked group; owners also invested in Necaxa; supporters' trust saved and ran the club 2011-21; cups = 23 Welsh Cups; no fan sanctions found.

name: Wycombe Wanderers
notes: Blue Ocean Partners II (Mikheil Lomtadze, Kaspi.kz) 80% since 2024, supporters' trust 10%; the trust owned the club 2012-20; no sanctions found.

name: York City
notes: 394 Sports (Uggla family, Canadian-linked) 51% since 2023, supporters' society 25%; trust owned the club 2003 and 2022; moved to the York Community Stadium in 2021; no sanctions found.

name: Žalgiris
notes: Businessman Tadas Burgaila majority since Nov 2025; Betsafe/Betsson shirt sponsor; bankrupt 2008-09 and rebuilt as a city association; objects thrown during 2025 fan protests; no women's team profile found.

name: Albania
notes: Euro 2024 UEFA fines and FIFA sanctions in 2025 (CHF 161,500, partial closures) for discriminatory chants; Freedom House Partly Free 69.

name: Algeria
notes: No FIFA discrimination sanctions in the 2026 cycle; FAF president is also sports minister; Freedom House Not Free 31. Stadium = Nelson Mandela Stadium, Baraki.

name: Andorra
notes: No sanctions or governance scandals found; Free democracy.

name: Argentina
notes: FIFA discrimination sanctions June 2025 and Aug 2026 (USD 321,000), 2024 Copa squad racist chant; post-2026-final assault proceedings; AFA president charged in tax-evasion case; state-owned YPF and Aerolineas Argentinas are AFA sponsors; Free 85 with press-freedom issues.

name: Armenia
notes: No discrimination sanctions found; Freedom House Partly Free 54.

name: Australia
notes: No sanctions; 2022 squad video on migrant-worker rights and same-sex marriage; continental = 2015 Asian Cup + 4 OFC Nations Cups; home games rotate (Stadium Australia used).

name: Austria
notes: No discrimination sanctions found; ÖFB leadership changes 2023-25, no corruption case.

name: Azerbaijan
notes: AFFA presidents are heads of state oil company SOCAR (sponsor); Freedom House Not Free 6.

name: Belarus
notes: Home games abroad behind closed doors since 2022 (UEFA ban over role in Russia's invasion of Ukraine); federation tied to the Lukashenko state; Not Free 7.

name: Belgium
notes: No national-team fan sanctions found; 2018 corruption case involved clubs/agents, not the federation.

name: Bosnia and Herzegovina
notes: Supporters mainly Bosniak-identified, pyro and occasional incidents, no major UEFA discrimination case; FIFA/UEFA suspension 2011 over ethnic presidency; Partly Free 54.

name: Brazil
notes: No FIFA discrimination sanction; CBF president removed by court 2025, three earlier presidents banned or convicted in FIFA corruption cases.

name: Bulgaria
notes: Racist abuse of England players Oct 2019 (UEFA closed-door matches, fine) and earlier sanctions, none found since 2019; fan protests against the federation.

name: Canada
notes: No discrimination sanctions; drone-spying scandal (staff bans, Olympic points deduction); equal-pay agreement for men's and women's teams; no fixed national stadium (BMO Field used).

name: Cape Verde
notes: No sanctions or governance scandals found.

name: Colombia
notes: FIFA discrimination sanction June 2025 (CHF 70,000, partial closure); ticketless fans stormed the 2024 Copa final; federation fined over ticket resale scheme, president arrested 2024 (charges dropped).

name: Croatia
notes: Recurring Ustaše symbols and far-right chants: 2015 swastika, Euro 2024 fines, 2025 closed-door match; former federation chief Mamić convicted of embezzlement.

name: Curaçao
notes: No sanctions found; coaching turmoil before 2026 finals; constituent country of the Kingdom of the Netherlands.

name: Cyprus
notes: No national-team sanctions found; club-level match-fixing investigations.

name: Czech Republic
notes: Betting firm Fortuna sponsors the federation; federation corruption raids 2017 and 2020; titles and appearances include Czechoslovakia (Euro 1976).

name: DR Congo
notes: No national-team sanctions; players protested eastern Congo violence at AFCON 2024; ex-president Omari arrested 2021 over embezzlement; Not Free 18.

name: Denmark
notes: No discrimination or violence sanctions; Oddset (Danske Spil, majority state-owned) is a national-team sponsor; 2025 agreement gives women equal base fees and bonuses; DBU openly critical of FIFA over Qatar.

name: Ecuador
notes: FIFA fine for homophobic chants at 2022 World Cup opener; Byron Castillo eligibility case (fine, 3-point deduction); Partly Free 64.

name: Egypt
notes: Fans capped or excluded since 2012 Port Said disaster and ultras crackdown; federation tied to the state; Not Free 18.

name: England
notes: Ticketless fans stormed Wembley at Euro 2020 final (UEFA closed-door match, fine); racist online abuse of players after that final and recurring nationalist chants; equal match fees for men and women.

name: Estonia
notes: No sanctions or scandals found.

name: Faroe Islands
notes: No sanctions found; part of the Danish realm.

name: Finland
notes: No sanctions or scandals found.

name: France
notes: Betclic (betting) is an FFF sponsor; FFF ban on players wearing the hijab (upheld 2023); president Le Graet resigned 2023 after audit and harassment allegations.

name: Georgia
notes: UEFA fine and spectator ban after pitch invasion, lasers and fireworks aimed at Armenian fans (March 2025); federation president is a Georgian Dream MP; Partly Free 51.

name: Germany
notes: No fan sanctions found; 2006 World Cup payments affair led to tax and criminal proceedings against former officials; home games rotate (Olympiastadion used).

name: Ghana
notes: No discrimination sanctions; 2018 'Number 12' bribery expose led to the old association's dissolution.

name: Gibraltar
notes: No sanctions found; political friction with Spain over fixtures.

name: Greece
notes: No national-team discrimination sanction found; FIFA suspension 2006 over political interference, 2015 match-fixing administration, ex-presidents convicted 2019.

name: Haiti
notes: Ex-president Yves Jean-Bart banned for life by FIFA (2020) over sexual abuse of players; no home games since 2021 due to gang violence; Not Free 22.

name: Hungary
notes: Far-right Carpathian Brigade; UEFA closed-door sanctions for homophobic banners (Euro 2020) and FIFA fan ban for racist abuse of England players (2021); federation chief close to the former Orban government; Partly Free 65.

name: Iceland
notes: No fan sanctions; KSI board resigned 2021 over handling of sexual-misconduct allegations against players.

name: Iran
notes: Long-running exclusion of women from stadiums, objected to Seattle Pride Match; federation controlled by the state; players who backed protesters pressured; Not Free 10.

name: Iraq
notes: No FIFA discrimination sanctions; fatal crush outside Basra stadium 2023; history of political interference; Not Free 31.

name: Israel
notes: IFA includes West Bank settlement clubs (suspension calls 2025); home games mostly in Hungary since 2023; Freedom House Free 73 but occupied territories Not Free.

name: Italy
notes: No national-team discrimination sanction found; betting advertising banned in Italian sport since 2019; FIGC president resigned April 2026.

name: Ivory Coast
notes: No sanctions; federation close to political power; Partly Free 46.

name: Japan
notes: No sanctions; fans known for cleaning stands; independent, transparent federation.

name: Jordan

name: Kazakhstan
notes: No fan sanctions found; federation close to the state; Not Free 23.

name: Kosovo
notes: No discrimination sanction found; walked off at Romania (2024) after pro-Serbia chants; Partly Free 61.

name: Latvia
